description: AI systems are increasingly deployed in large-scale, autonomous, open-domain situations.

instances.assertion: AI systems are increasingly deployed in large-scale, autonomous, open-domain situations.
AI systems are increasingly being integrated into corporate processes, with some models reaching 800 million weekly active users.
AI systems are increasingly integrated into society, leading to risks like biased hiring and stereotypical text-to-image generation.
AI systems are increasingly being integrated into multi-agent collaborative frameworks, which introduces new risks of cascading failures and unpredictable behaviors.
AI systems are increasingly being used to facilitate financial fraud, including through the use of generative AI.
